first_90_day_anchors.note: Choir is #1. Choose only one or two major recurring anchors initially.

arrival_grace.rule: Do not evaluate whether California was a mistake during the first 14 days.
focus: one familiar restaurant or coffee option
normal_outcomes: overspending somewhat in the first month
dogs acting differently for several days
discovering the first neighborhood is not forever
needing months rather than days to rebuild community
arrival_grace.system_rule: None of the above is project failure. Do not let the readiness report treat them as red.
